answer: Each challenge is generated from a domain-separated hash of task parameters and a future, unbiasable drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse, so its unpredictable value is unavailable when a swarm precomputes answers or farms them offline. Commit-reveal binds each response to that pulse; labels such as umber and plume can separate challenge domains, but duplicate identities gain no shortcut, and admission costs plus verification remain necessary to limit Sybils.
